input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: This is a hosting and licensing agreement in which TrueLink holds Client Content and Credit Data, but no exit provision exists. Section 13 only confirms that Client retains ownership of its domains and Client Content and makes Client responsible for arranging a new name server/hosting environment within 30/60 days; Section 14 merely continues services until the end of the month following notice. Neither obliges TrueLink to provide transition assistance, to return or export our data in a usable format, or to delete and certify deletion afterwards, and Section 10 contains no return-of-materials mechanic. That falls short of even the fallback (90 days of assistance plus export within 30 days), so we insert the preferred transition/data-return paragraph in the termination section, noting the 90-day fallback in the comment.

ops.text: Transition Assistance and Return of Client Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Client's request, return to Client all Client Content, Credit Data and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems (including backup media, subject to any applicable legal retention requirements) and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a transition-assistance and data-return provision to Section 14, since the Agreement currently gives us no right to our own data or to migration help on exit. Our position is up to six months of assistance at your then-current rates with data returned in machine-readable form within 30 days and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept 90 days of assistance if that works better for you.
proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return within 30 days, and certified deletion into Section 14 (Termination).
